description: This source file contains a suite of unit tests for various SwiftUI views and controllers within the OpenClaw project. The tests validate the construction of views, their bodies, and some interaction logic for components like context menus, toggle rows, voice wake test cards, agent events window, overlay controllers, visual effect views, menu hosted items, dock icon management, and settings helpers.

methods.name: context menu card builds body
methods.description: Tests the rendering of ContextMenuCardView with different states and rows.

methods.name: settings toggle row builds body
methods.description: Validates the creation of SettingsToggleRow with a binding toggle.

methods.name: voice wake test card builds body across states
methods.description: Checks the body rendering of VoiceWakeTestCard across various voice states.

methods.name: agent events window builds body with event
methods.description: Verifies that AgentEventsWindow correctly displays an agent event after inserting it into the store.

methods.name: notify overlay presents and dismisses
methods.description: Simulates presenting and dismissing notify overlays.

methods.name: talk overlay presents twice and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presenting, updating, and dismissing the talk overlay.

methods.name: visual effect view hosts in NS hosting view
methods.description: Tests the embedding of VisualEffectView inside an NSHostingView and resizing.

methods.name: menu hosted item hosts content
methods.description: Tests hosting a menu item view within an NSHostingView.

methods.name: dock icon manager updates visibility
methods.description: Tests toggling the dock icon visibility via DockIconManager.

methods.name: voice wake settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Calls helper functions related to voice wake settings.

methods.name: debug settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Executes debug settings helper functions asynchronously.
